approaches.title: Microscopic monotone coupling
approaches.mechanism: Natural spin-order comparison and pathwise block invariant regions
approaches.strongest_result: The increasing cylinder observable has generator values2+sigma and1+sigma at comparable states. A30-adjacent-swap positive-rate path moves a triangular block profile outside its initial interior rectangle.
approaches.exact_gap_or_limit: Rules out this coordinatewise attractive coupling and exact pathwise block maximum principle, not all couplings or asymptotic invariant regions.
approaches.proof_location: REPORT.md, section Approach 1 Microscopic monotone coupling

approaches.title: Affine entropy invariant regions
approaches.mechanism: Distributional nonnegative transport inequalities for positive parts of affine Leroux entropies
approaches.strongest_result: Four initial entropy sign constraints propagate by bounded-speed cone cutoffs and preserve a declared Riemann rectangle.
approaches.exact_gap_or_limit: Requires the corresponding initial entropy terms or strong L1 trace; does not establish positive-wave decay.
approaches.proof_location: REPORT.md, section Approach 2 Affine entropy invariant regions

approaches.title: Inviscid weighted characteristic gradients
approaches.mechanism: Cancel cross-gradients by dividing each invariant derivative by the hyperbolicity gap
approaches.strongest_result: D_+(a_x/d)=−2d(a_x/d)^2 and D_−(b_x/d)=−2d(b_x/d)^2 give a_x,b_x<=M/(2delta t) for smooth solutions with0<delta<=d<=M.
approaches.exact_gap_or_limit: Classical chain rule and characteristics do not extend automatically across stochastic-limit shocks or d=0.
approaches.proof_location: REPORT.md, section Approach 3 Inviscid weighted characteristic gradients

approaches.title: Viscous maximum principle
approaches.mechanism: Apply scalar parabolic derivative comparison to the physical isotropic-viscosity approximation
approaches.strongest_result: The exact equation for P=a_x/d contains−2nu P Q_x; a strict-interior smooth jet gives positive production at a positive spatial maximum.
approaches.exact_gap_or_limit: Refutes the naive differential comparison, not every possible viscous bound; stochastic replacement and martingale errors remain additional gaps.
approaches.proof_location: REPORT.md, section Approach 4 Viscous maximum principle

approaches.title: Invariant two-species face reduction
approaches.mechanism: Use exact microscopic absent-species invariance and inherited scalar entropy theory
approaches.strongest_result: For all three affine faces, the weak-Cauchy/interior-entropy inputs imply scalar quadratic Kruzhkov uniqueness and D_x a,D_x b<=1/(2t), including the degenerate point on rho=0.
approaches.exact_gap_or_limit: Applies only to globally absent microscopic species or separately justified face-valued limits. Does not settle the three-state interior.
approaches.proof_location: REPORT.md, section Approach 5 Invariant two-species face reduction
